——————————————————————
还真是够巧的!
苏沐瞧着眼前这个身穿警服,体格健硕,颧骨凸起的男子,脸上露出公式化的笑容,“杨所长,来汇报工作?”
“是的,这不是来找镇长汇报汇报这段时间派出所的工作情况嘛。苏副镇长,好几天没见你,你跑哪去了?”杨虎大声道,像是怕谁听不到似的。
“办事!”苏沐淡然道。笑话,我怎么说都是副镇长,去哪还需要向你汇报吗?你又算哪根葱?
“办事啊?公事还是私事那?”杨虎皮笑肉不笑道。
就在这时办公室里面突然传出一阵咳嗽声,杨虎剩下的话便没有说出,全部吞到肚子里,让开道路,和苏沐错身而过的时候低声道:“苏副镇长,你最好识相,在这黑山镇还由不得你这么自由,想去哪就去哪。”
苏沐心底不屑的冷哼一声,懒得理会杨虎,推门走进去,冲着坐在宽大办公桌后面的杨松恭声道:“杨镇长,你找我?”
和杨虎不同,杨松的体型很瘦,穿着件深灰色的衬衣,一条眉毛很细很淡,给人的第一感觉便是阴沉颇有心计。
然而随着苏沐说完这句话,接下来发生的一幕让他真的有些吃惊,没想到一向以玩弄心计著称的杨松,会做出这样的举动。
杨松猛地起立,狠狠的拍了一下桌子,在钢笔都跳起的同时,瞪着苏沐大声道:“苏沐,你还有没有点组织性纪律性,身为黑山镇副镇长,一连八天不出现,你到底想要怎样?就算有事,有事不能提前请假吗?难道我党的规定全都是摆设不成?失踪八天不见人影,回来又不马上过来汇报,你以为你是谁?
我还从来没有见过像你这么散漫,这么目无组织的人!就你还配是国家公务人员?就你这样的还能成为黑山镇副镇长?行了,你什么也别说了,回去等着通知吧。这件事,我不会这么算了的,你有个心理准备!”
有个心理准备是官场上很为奇妙的一句话,你可以当作是组织上要考虑你能不能进步,也可以当作是想着将你拿下。当然这种情况之下,杨松的想法很是显而易见,那就是将苏沐免职。
原来你打的是这样的如意算盘!
苏沐从进来连汇报的机会都没有,便被杨松劈头盖脸的一顿训斥,他这么做无非就是想要先声夺人。我不管你有什么理由,反正这个责任你得背。早就想要收拾你,你都这样主动送上门,我岂能放过?
换做是以前的话,苏沐或许会不知道该怎么办,但消化掉官榜中那么多权谋之术,现在的他早就脱胎换骨。如果连一个小小的镇长都应付不了,以后还怎么混?县级,市级,甚至省级的博弈厮杀,那就更是想都别想。
苏沐安静的听着杨松训斥完,随即很为平淡道:“杨镇长,我想你误会了,我并没有消失,而是去了盛京。至于失踪八天我也能解释,因为我已经向梁书记请过假了,你要是不相信的话,可以当面向他求证。至于你说的心理准备,我一直都有。不过我想杨镇长你恐怕代表不了党代表不了组织吧?”
绵里藏针的辩解!
你杨松不想听那是你的事,我得解释。你如果真的不要这个脸,非要撕破和我为难的话。抱歉,我苏沐也不是谁想揉捏便能揉捏的。
想要罢掉我,你杨松还没有这个资格!

“你这是什么态度?”杨松怒声道。
“我什么态度?我公平公正的态度啊。我实事求是的汇报情况,难道这也有事?杨镇长,很抱歉,我还有些事情要向梁书记汇报,先过去了。”苏沐很为平静的转身,走出去关上大门。
就在苏沐离开的同时,办公室内响起一道清脆的咣当声,怒急攻心的杨松一下子将杯子摔碎。
“嚣张!太嚣张了!苏沐,你个毛头小子,敢这么和我说话。你真以为后面有着梁昌贵做后台我便拿你没办法吗?你等着,你们蹦跶不了几天了,等到梁昌贵倒台,我看谁还能救你们!”杨松满脸阴森。
黑山镇的镇政府和镇委同在一座楼,只不过镇委在左边,镇政府在右边,两者泾渭分明的分开着,彼此谁也不碍谁的事。
镇委书记办公室。
“梁书记,我又给你惹祸了!”现在的苏沐和刚才在杨松那里完全就是两样,很为恭敬的说道。

content_en:
————————————————————————
What a coincidence!
Su Mu looked at the man in front of him, who was wearing a police uniform and had a strong build and raised cheekbones, with a formulaic smile on his face, "Director Yang, are you here to report on your work?"
"Yes, I'm here to report to the mayor on the work of the police station during this period. Deputy Mayor Su, I haven't seen you for several days, where have you been?" Yang Hu said loudly, as if he was afraid that no one would hear.
"Doing business!" Su Mu said calmly. What a joke, I am the deputy mayor no matter what, do I still need to report to you wherever I go? Who are you?
"Are you doing something? Business or private?" Yang Hupi said with a smile.
At this moment, there was a sudden cough in the office. Yang Hu didn't say the rest of the words. He swallowed them all and got out of the way. As he passed by Su Mu, he whispered: "Deputy Mayor Su, you better know the truth. You are not allowed to be so free in this Black Mountain Town. You can go wherever you want."
Su Mu snorted disdainfully in her heart, and was too lazy to pay attention to Yang Hu. She pushed the door open and walked in. She respectfully said to Yang Song who was sitting behind the large desk: "Mayor Yang, are you looking for me?"
Unlike Yang Hu, Yang Song is very thin, wearing a dark gray shirt, and has very thin and light eyebrows. The first impression he gives is that he is gloomy and scheming.
However, after Su Mu finished saying this, the scene that happened next really surprised him. He didn't expect that Yang Song, who was always known for his scheming, would do such a thing.
Yang Song stood up suddenly, slapped the table hard, and with the pen jumping up, he glared at Su Mu and said loudly: "Su Mu, do you still have some organizational discipline? As the deputy mayor of Heishan Town, you haven't shown up for eight days in a row. What do you want? Even if you have something to do, can't you ask for leave in advance? Are all our party's regulations just for show? You haven't been seen for eight days, and you haven't reported immediately when you come back. Who do you think you are?"
I have never seen someone as unorganized and disorganized as you! Are you worthy of being a national civil servant? Can you be the deputy mayor of Heishan Town? Okay, don't say anything, go back and wait for notification. I won’t let this matter go, so be mentally prepared!”
There is a very strange saying in the officialdom: psychological preparation. You can think of it as the organization considering whether you can make progress, or it can think of it as thinking about taking you down. Of course, under this situation, Yang Song's idea was very obvious, which was to remove Su Mu from his post.
It turns out you had such a wishful thinking!
Su Mu didn't even have a chance to report when he came in, so he was scolded by Yang Song. He just wanted to get the upper hand. I don't care what your reasons are, you have to shoulder this responsibility anyway. I have wanted to deal with you for a long time, but you have already taken the initiative to come to my door like this. How can I let you go?
In the past, Su Mu might not know what to do, but after digesting so many tactics in the official list, he has long been reborn. If you can't even deal with a small town mayor, how can you survive in the future? Don't even think about fighting at the county level, city level, or even provincial level.
Su Mu listened quietly to Yang Song's reprimand, and then said calmly: "Mayor Yang, I think you misunderstood. I did not disappear, but went to Shengjing. As for the eight days of disappearance, I can also explain it, because I have already asked for leave from Secretary Liang. If you don't believe it, you can ask him for confirmation in person. As for the psychological preparation you mentioned, I have always been prepared. But I guess Mayor Yang, you can't represent the party or the organization, right?"
The defense of hidden needles in cotton wool!
If you Yang Song doesn't want to hear it, that's your business. I have to explain. If you really don't want this face and insist on tearing it apart and making things difficult for me. Sorry, I, Su Mu, can't be kneaded by anyone who wants to.
If you want to get rid of me, you, Yang Song, are not qualified yet!
"What are you doing?What attitude?" Yang Song said angrily.
"What is my attitude? My attitude is fair and just. I reported the situation realistically, is there anything wrong with that? Mayor Yang, I'm sorry, I still have some things to report to Secretary Liang, so I'll go over there first. "Su Mu turned around very calmly, walked out and closed the door.
Just as Su Mu left, there was a crisp banging sound in the office, and an angry Yang Song suddenly smashed the cup.
"Arrogant! Too arrogant! Su Mu, you little brat, how dare you talk to me like that. Do you really think that I can't do anything to you with Liang Changgui behind you? Just wait, you won't be able to dance for a few days. When Liang Changgui falls, I'll see who can save you!" Yang Song had a gloomy face.
The town government and the town committee of Heishan Town are in the same building, but the town committee is on the left and the town government is on the right. The two are clearly separated, and neither one interferes with the other.
Town Party Secretary's Office.
"Secretary Liang, I've caused you trouble again!" Su Mu now was completely different from Yang Song just now, and she said very respectfully.
